# msknockoffs

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

msknockoffs helps to find a set of variables that are associated with a response $y$. This package contains a main algorithm that is able to use $K$ datasets of gene expression data. It calculates knockoffs from two methods (sequential and second-order), $Z$ and $Z$-knockoff statistics of the $K$ datasets, creates a combination of all knockoffs with help of OSFF function, calculates $W$ statistics and the threshold, and finally returns a selection of variables.
